defect: none; static division and a falling-edge clock-enable latch prevent a runt gated pulse
rationale: The enable is synchronized to the input clock and latched only on its falling edge. The divided clock is therefore disabled or enabled only while its source phase is low; the generated-clock relation describes the fixed divide-by-four counter phase.

mutation.description: Reduced the static divider to a fixed four-state counter and retained synchronized, falling-edge-latched gating.

provenance.adaptation: Self-contained fixed divider with the source module's safe enable interface.
